description: 在 PikPak 中遍历目录并本地匹配文件名/路径，支持 AND/OR、正则、file/folder/any、排序及 JSON。用于云盘搜索、找文件或文件夹。 Use when searching a PikPak drive for files or folders by name or path: keyword, AND/OR, regex, sort by name/size/time, JSON output. Traverses directories locally; does not rely on a server-side search API.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
